preconditions.description: The input must be a string.
The input string can be of any length, including empty.

postconditions.expression: stdout == ''.join(c * int(n) for n, c in zip(re.findall(r'\d+', s), re.findall(r'[a-zA-Z]', s)))
postconditions.description: The output string is the expansion of the input string based on the numeric values preceding each character.
If the input string is empty, the output must also be an empty string.
